messages:
jordan: Heads-up — embed-worker is intermittently returning 503s from eu-west1 since ~23:15 UTC. Root cause looks like a race in the memo cache (investigating). PR with hotfix: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4123. Need expedited deploy in the 02:00-02:30 UTC change window. Requesting 2 approvals + oncall ack.
liam: I can be oncall for the window. +1 for expedited.
deploybot: CI report for PR #4123 — unit: ✅, integration: ✅, e2e: ✅, load-tests: flaky (ignored per policy). Candidate image: gcr.io/redwood/embed-worker:sha-def456. Current prod image: sha-abc123.
sophie: Need a rollback play and a pin. Also add a short release note draft.
jordan: Rollback plan (short): ```kubectl set image deployment/embed-worker embed-worker=gcr.io/redwood/embed-worker:sha-abc123 && kubectl rollout status deployment/embed-worker -n prod``` Pining candidate image: sha-def456.
anya: Can we skip canary for speed? Traffic in eu-west1 is low right now but want to be safe. What are the skip criteria?
liam: Canary skip OK if: 1) candidate passed integration & e2e, 2) staging canary ran for 10m with zero 5xx, 3) ops engineer present during window. All met. I'm approving the canary skip for eu-west1. @jordan you still need one more approval.
maya: +1 :thumbsup:
deploybot: Canary bypass requested by liam. Authorization validated. Policy: skip_canary=true for this job run. Recording approvers: liam, maya.
jordan: Executing deploy: `/deploy release embed-worker --image sha-def456 --region eu-west1 --skip-canary` Starting at 02:03 UTC.
deploybot: STARTING DEPLOY (eu-west1) — draining old pods -> pulling image sha-def456 -> applying rollout. Logs:
- draining 2 pods
- updating 6 replicas
- image pulled on nodes
- waiting for readiness checks
deploybot: READY: 6/6 pods updated and ready. Post-deploy health checks running (120s window).
deploybot: POST-DEPLOY METRICS (rolling 5m): 503-rate before: 0.91% -> after: 0.02%. p99 latency: 320ms -> 325ms (within SLO). No obvious errors in logs.
sophie: Nice — please update the release note and tag the customer-facing doc.
jordan: Release note draft: "hotfix(embed-worker): fix race in memo cache causing intermittent 503s in EU; rolled back to stable if regressions observed. Deployed candidate sha-def456 to eu-west1 at 02:03 UTC. Rollback command included in ops runbook."
releasebot: Saved release note to shared doc: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/4123-hotfix-embed-worker. Changelog entry created.
maya: confirmed monitoring alerts cleared, metric dashboards green :party_parrot:
liam: Since all checks look good and rollback plan is simple, I approve closing this out. Recommend backport to the 1.8.x branch later today.
jordan: Will file backport PR and update the changelog. Closing thread — final check at 02:30 UTC: all systems nominal. Thanks team!
